observations: Three photos show two headlamps wrapped in clear plastic, lying on a concrete or dirt surface.
The headlamps are large, with a curved, elongated shape typical of mid-2000s sedans.
Each headlamp has a main circular projector lens, a smaller circular lens (likely for turn signal or side marker), and a larger rectangular or oval section (possibly for the main beam or fog light).
The plastic wrapping is crinkled and reflects light, making some internal details hard to see.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the headlamps themselves.
The seller claims they are 'Very Clean Toyota Camry Headlamps 2006 model'.
The photos show no signs of damage or cracks on the outer lens, but internal components are obscured by the plastic wrap.
